zhu.title: Weil positivity in compact windows: a finite reduction, certified two-sided bounds, and a Landau-Widom decay law
zhu.author: Xuefeng Zhu
zhu.dates: Submitted on 25 Aug 2026 (v1); last revised 2 Sep 2026 (v2)
zhu.claim_sentence: We prove by certified computation that Q(f) >= 8.9e-18 ||f||^2 for all supp f in [-0.8,0.8], i.e. autocorrelation support 1.6, 2.3 times the classical range.
zhu.scope_sentence: We show why the positivity route cannot reach RH unassisted: any one-stroke certificate must resolve frequencies up to 2 pi e^{A_L}, A_L ~ 4e^L, a doubly exponential threshold that no pointwise bound on the prime comb lowers, while the spectral margin collapses at the Landau-Widom rate.
zhu.first_sentence: Weil's criterion states that the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) is equivalent to the non-negativity of an explicit quadratic form Q(f) on test functions.
